champions.name: Viego
champions.tldr: Innate: Whenever an enemy champion is killed by Viego or dies within 3 seconds of being damaged by him, a Mist Wraith spawns from their corpse for 8 seconds. Viego can basic attack a Mist Wraith to possess it, heal hi…
champions.gameplayImpact: Viego is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate: Whenever an enemy champion is killed by Viego or dies within 3 seconds of being damaged by him, a Mist Wraith spawns from their corpse for 8 seconds. Viego can basic attack a Mist Wraith to possess it, heal himself for 8%|health (+ 2.5% per 100 bonus AD) (+ 1.5% per 100 AP) (+ 2.5% per 100% bonus attack speed) of the target's maximum health, and blink to its location after winding up for 1 second, during which he is untargetable (except to turrets).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Possession lasts for 10 seconds and replaces Viego's basic attacks, basic abilities, items, base stats (based on Viego's level), and appearance with the champion the Mist Wraith was summoned by and grants him a free cast of Heartbreaker}} that is initially placed on a 1.5-second cooldown. Viego also gains 10% bonus movement speed while moving toward nearby enemy champions during this time.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Viego cannot use item actives, consumable items, nor the shop while under possession.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Viego will preserve his current health percentage between transformations.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Passive: Viego's basic attacks deal 2–6% of the target's current health bonus physical damage on-hit. The bonus damage has a minimum threshold of 10–30 and is capped at 80 against monster.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Additionally, Viego's damaging abilities apply a mark to enemies for 4 seconds. Viego's next basic attack against a marked target consumes the mark to strike twice, with the second strike dealing 20% AD (+ 15% AP) physical damage and heal him for 150% of the damage dealt, increased to 155% against monsters. The second strike is affected by critical strike modifiers and, while not under Sovereign's Domination|possession}}, it applies on-hit effects at 100% effectiveness.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Viego thrusts his blade in the target direction, dealing 25–85 (+ 60% AD) physical damage to enemies hit, increased by 0–75% (0–100% crit)|critical chance, and 10 bonus physical damage against monsters.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Blade of the Ruined King's passive remains under Sovereign's Domination|possession}}.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cooldown: 5–3 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Viego channel while being slow by 15% for up to 3 seconds to increase Spectral Maw's mist missile range and stun duration over the first second of the channel. Spectral Maw can be recast at any time within its duration.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: If the charge completes without reactivation, Spectral Maw is canceled and goes on full cooldown.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Recast: Viego hurls a blast of mist in the target direction and dash a fixed distance in the same direction, though not through terrain. The mist deals 80–300 (+ 100% AP) magic damage to the first enemy struck and stun them for 0.25–1.25 (lv 0–1) seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: If the charge is interrupt, Spectral Maw resumes a 3-second static cooldown.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Spectral Maw Basic attack reset Viego's basic attack timer.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: While inside the mist, Viego gains 30–50% bonus attack speed and, if he is not attacking or casting, he becomes camouflage and gains 20–30% (+ 4% per 100 AP) bonus movement speed.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the camouflage and remove the bonus movement speed, preventing Viego from gaining them again for 0.6 seconds, refreshing upon further attacks and ability casts.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Harrowed Path can be cast during any of Viego's abilities.

lines.note: Upon arrival, Viego creates a blast that deals 120% AD physical damage to all nearby enemies, increased by 0–75% (0–100% crit)|critical chance, and airborne all but one up-to 400 units away based on proximity.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The enemy champion, , is not knocked back and instead takes the blow from Viego's blade, which deals 15–25 (3 ranks)% bonus physical damage, slow them by 99% for 0.5 seconds, and applies on-hit effects at 100% effectiveness.
